question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/afb5086264d443e68628c72c8b9818ef84b56d0e8c67282e584435387ed2444a.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) The number of slant lines are increasing subsequently.

2) The numeric element shifts anticlockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4053156f8085fb639f608e9e901530bf1b7e3b3162641b2d3ff2a6dacf5db8c1.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c7c6795191cc060bbc25a7e3e9d6c64dc13299817f66aa70bbba4aecf8870f0.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
